- The Mariana Trench bottom conditions are approximately 1,086 bar (108.6 MPa) pressure and 4°C temperature (peak temperature).
- At these conditions (4°C, 1,086 bar), Freon-12 (R-12) is a compressed liquid since the temperature (4°C) is well below the critical temperature (111.97°C) and the pressure (1,086 bar) is well above the critical pressure (41.36 bar).
- Using CoolProp thermodyn
